### Marcus Theatres Appoints Shannah Miller Senior Vice President of Marketing and Sales


September 28, 2026


MILWAUKEE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Marcus Theatres®](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcustheatres.com%2F&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Theatres%C2%AE&index=1&md5=46f0d1740b0d0c11832be920ddaa8fcd) , the nation’s fourth largest theatre circuit and a division of[Marcus Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation&index=2&md5=f7402ae13c159c808e11c5d2aae0df17) (NYSE: MCS), announced today that Shannah Miller has been appointed senior vice president of marketing and sales, effective October 19. With more than 20 years of experience in entertainment and content distribution, Miller brings deep experience in marketing strategy, audience development, partnerships, and revenue growth to her new role.


Shannah Miller, senior vice president of marketing and sales at Marcus Theatres


“Shannah has extensive entertainment industry experience and a proven track record of connecting audiences with compelling content while increasing brand awareness and driving business growth,” said Jeff Tomachek, president of Marcus Theatres. “Her strategic perspective and strong industry relationships will be invaluable as we continue to evolve our marketing and sales strategies across our circuit. We are excited to welcome Shannah to Marcus Theatres and look forward to her leadership as we build on our momentum to continue delivering memorable moments for our moviegoers.”


Most recently, Miller served as vice president of marketing for Fathom Entertainment, where she led marketing and communications strategies for the brand and more than 100 theatrical releases annually, spanning anime, music, faith-based programming, repertory films, gaming, sports and original content. Prior to joining Fathom Entertainment, Miller held leadership positions at Atom Tickets and Sony Music. In these roles, she led marketing, communications and partnership initiatives for the organizations as well as major entertainment brands and globally recognized artists.


Miller holds a Bachelor of Arts in Journalism and a Business Management Certificate from New York University.


**About Marcus Theatres**


[Marcus Theatres®](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcustheatres.com%2F&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Theatres%C2%AE&index=3&md5=a547be64676d9299d9a65fa2a3238072) , a division of[Marcus Corporation,](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation%2C&index=4&md5=056a370d8f997dc3165cfea6e035867f) is the fourth-largest theatre circuit in the United States and currently owns or operates 975 screens at 77 locations in 17 states under the Marcus Theatres, Movie Tavern® by Marcus and Bistro *Plex* ® brands. For more information, please visit[www.marcustheatres.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcustheatres.com%2F&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=www.marcustheatres.com&index=5&md5=1a9d7b21cdb45d8adb313c3d6ac0ab58) and follow the company on[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FMarcusTheatres&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=6&md5=4e7f9578b69a282599b32b159a772212) ,[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fmarcustheatres%2F%3Fhl%3Den&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=7&md5=8adef3a11ffbd28637f23a2c66b474e0) , and[TikTok](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40marcustheatres%3Flang%3Den&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=TikTok&index=8&md5=6cd4c8d271e532c29ba95684ba47a989) .


**About Marcus Corporation**


Headquartered in Milwaukee,[Marcus Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation&index=9&md5=5258c358dc75d07c295d065c11705b01) is a leader in the entertainment and hospitality industries, with significant company-owned real estate assets. In addition to its Marcus Theatres division, its hospitality division,[Marcus®Hotels & Resorts](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcushotels.com%2F&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus%C2%AEHotels+%26+Resorts&index=10&md5=19599b1afd771d7c4f28a511d29e2605) , owns and/or manages 17 hotels, resorts and other properties in eight states. For more information, please visit the company’s website at[www.marcuscorp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F&esheet=54611785&newsitemid=20260927445151&lan=en-US&anchor=www.marcuscorp.com&index=11&md5=1224cc00367827b6ef31e86fd36fdf53) .
